TSB Revision
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE OVERHAUL
23B-58
>>F<< CLUTCH PLATE/CLUTCH DISC/CLUTCH REACTION 
PLATE INSTALLATION
CAUTION
Immerse the clutch disc in ATF before assembling it. 
Especially if the clutch disc is new, use it only after it has 
been immersed in ATF for at least two hours.
1. Assemble two clutch discs and two clutch plates, one on top 
of the other, inside the reverse clutch retainer. Assemble 
both clutch plates so that the places with no teeth (marked 
"A") are aligned with the holes in the retainer (marked "B").
2. Install the clutch reaction plate in the direction shown. In the 
same way as the clutch plate, assemble them so that the 
places with no teeth (marked "A") are aligned with the holes 
in the retainer (marked "B").
>>G<< SNAP RING INSTALLATION
1. Install the snap ring into the groove of reverse clutch 
retainer.
2. Set special tools MB991790 <F4A42> or MB991789 
<F4A51> and MD998924 as shown in the illustration, and 
compress the clutch element.
3. Check that the clearance between the snap ring and the 
clutch reaction plate is within the standard value. If not within 
the standard value, select a snap ring to adjust.
Standard value: 1.5 − 1.7 mm (0.0591 − 0.0669 inch)
